literal_source_claim: Every sufficiently large even number can be expressed as the sum of a prime and an almost prime.
canonical_claim: Every sufficiently large even natural number is the sum of a prime and a natural number that is either prime or a product of two primes, with repeated prime factors allowed.
domain_and_universes: Expected natural numbers in Type; exact source may state positive integers. Coercion and positivity conventions remain open.
quantifiers: for every natural N at least N0
if N is even, exists natural p and a with N = p + a

excluded_degenerate_cases: The uniform threshold handles small even numbers. Zero and one do not count as P2; a prime and a square of a prime do count; repeated factors are allowed; the equality is N = p + a.
